note: Answer key for whether document reading keeps what one SOP needs and leaves out the rest. Each target is the SOP someone is writing, stated as the purpose and scope they would have given. `pnpm measure:extraction` reads the document once per target and scores the kept passages by their quotes: `needed` should be kept, `notRelevant` and `aboutTheDocument` should not. The same document is scored against two targets, so a reader that ignores the target cannot pass both.

purpose: Describe how a front-end cashier closes out at the end of the night shift.
scope: Applies to front-end cashiers working the closing shift.
needed: stop accepting new transactions at 11:00 PM
more than 15 minutes past the scheduled clock-out time
asks the Team Lead on duty before continuing
may change the order of closing tasks or defer non-urgent tasks
notRelevant: arrives 30 minutes before the store opens
present when the alarm is disarmed
cleaning products approved by Store Operations
aboutTheDocument: review proposed changes to this policy

purpose: Describe how the opening team opens the store each morning.
scope: Applies to the opening team at each store.
needed: arrives 30 minutes before the store opens
present when the alarm is disarmed
notRelevant: more than 15 minutes past the scheduled clock-out time
stop accepting new transactions at 11:00 PM
aboutTheDocument: review proposed changes to this policy
